Function try_get_l1_to_l2_membership_witness

pub unconstrained fn try_get_l1_to_l2_membership_witness(
    message_hash: Field,
    nullifier: Option<UnsiloedNullifier>,
) -> Option<(Field, [Field; 36])>

Returns the leaf index and sibling path of an entry in the L1 to L2 messaging tree, or None if there is no such entry.

When nullifier is Some, None is also returned if the message has already been consumed. Pass None to retrieve the witness regardless of whether the message has been consumed.
